Container.Name: grokive
Container.Overview: Download your Grok Imagine favourites and Agent canvases, then browse them in a fast, modern web app (full-text prompt search, favorites, stash, playlists, MP4 export, optional Whisper subtitles, themes, installable PWA). Click Sync in the web UI to fetch new media and rebuild the index; click Config to paste your browser cURL (login cookies) and set appearance/subtitle options. All data is stored in the mapped /data appdata folder.
Container.Description: Grokive — a self-hosted Grok Imagine archiver with a modern SvelteKit web UI (search, favorites, stash, playlists, MP4 export, optional Whisper subtitles, themes, PWA). Use the Sync button to run the downloader and rebuild the index; use Config to store the captured cURL request and settings. Optionally protect the UI with BASIC_AUTH_USER / BASIC_AUTH_PASS, or place it behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Data (appdata)
Config.Description: Stores cURL config, metadata, the SQLite index, media, thumbnails and settings

Config.Name: Admin User
Config.Description: Login username for the web UI (auth is on by default)

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Login password. Leave blank and a strong one is generated on first run and printed to the log (and saved to /data/admin_password.txt).

Config.Name: Disable Auth
Config.Description: Set to true to turn OFF the login (open UI). Only on a fully trusted, isolated LAN.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when behind an HTTPS reverse proxy (real client IPs + Secure session cookie)

Config.Name: Whisper Server URL
Config.Description: Optional: whisper-asr-webservice endpoint (e.g. http://host:9000/asr) to enable subtitle generation

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: GPU passthrough for NVENC (playlist merges / subtitle burn-in). 'all' exposes every GPU, or set a specific 'GPU-<uuid>' (from nvidia-smi -L). Requires --runtime=nvidia (already in Extra Parameters) and the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Driver capabilities exposed to the container. 'all' includes 'video' (required for NVENC) and 'utility' (nvidia-smi).

Config.Name: Video Encoder
Config.Description: Re-encoder for playlist merges and burned-in subtitles. 'auto' uses the NVIDIA GPU (NVENC) when visible, else CPU libx264. Force with 'nvenc' or 'cpu'.
